verdict.rationale: Sentry ships first-party Agents Dashboards with widgets for duration (average and P95 latency), errors, model cost, token usage and tool errors, so three of the four metrics are visualized out of the box. The evidence describes only these prebuilt dashboards; nothing shows a user building or customizing their own dashboard, and eval scores are never mentioned. missing for 10: documented ability to create or customize dashboards and widgets, eval-score metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics

citations.quote: View agent executions, model costs, token usage, tool calls, and recent errors in the Agents Dashboards.
The Model Cost widget shows estimated costs based on token usage and model pricing.
**Duration**: Displays average and P95 response times for your agent executions
The Tools dashboard displays Tool Calls and Tool Errors widgets
